svg.title: records
svg.desc: records: a recorded terminal session, 8 s, looping. Steps: #14 · records: ADRs, changelog fragments, towncrier check

g.text: - `mandrake setup` installs the `--embed` builds of abtop and gitlogue when tui-embed is chosen, and `mandrake doctor` c
- Decision records in `docs/adr/`, the architecture in `docs/ATLAS.toml`, the abbreviations in `docs/TERMS.md`, this cha
ngelog built from fragments in `docs/news/`, and a one-screen `CONTRIBUTING.md`. (#14)
- The Rust workspace moved from `pkgs/` to `rust/`; `pkgs/` is left for distribution packages (ADR-0002). (#7)
- A copy that fails midway is undone by `mandrake link rollback`, two runs in the same second keep separate journals and
backups, `doctor` accepts a correct copy, and `setup --cli` applies nothing when its input closes early. (#6)
(a branch that changes a file and adds no fragment)
